map.根管长度与工作长度计算器 使用指南: Root Canal Length and Working Length Calculator User Guide
map.由 X 线片测得牙长与放大率换算实际牙长，结合根尖止点设定计算根管工作长度(WL: Convert the tooth length measured from a radiograph and the magnification factor into the true tooth length, then combine it with the apical stop setting to obtain the root canal working length (WL).
map.术前根尖片测牙长，输入放大率后工具换算真实牙长，预估工作长度。: Take a preoperative periapical film to measure the tooth length, enter the magnification factor and the tool converts to the true tooth length and estimates the working length.
map.根尖孔未闭合年轻恒牙，提示工作长度止于根管口附近并谨慎预备。: For a young permanent tooth with an open apex, place the working length near the canal orifice and prepare cautiously.
map.再治疗核对旧充填到达位置与现止点差异。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考，不替: Re-treatment: check the difference between the old filling extent and the current stop. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening only and do not replace an oral examination, radiographic assessment such as periapical films or CBCT, or diagnosis and treatment by a dentist, orthodontist or periodontist; if you have tooth pain, bleeding gums, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or discomfort on biting, please see a dentist at a proper hospital promptly.)
map.：输入：片上牙长 22mm，放大率 1.1，根尖止点距根尖 0.5mm\n计算：:
Input: tooth length on the film 22 mm, magnification 1.1, apical stop 0.5 mm short of the apex
Calculation: true tooth length = 22 / 1.1 = 20 mm; working length WL = 20 − 0.5 = 19.5 mm
Note: in practice confirm with an electronic apex locator combined with the radiograph.
map.舌诊（中医）与口腔健康关联器: Tongue Diagnosis (Traditional Chinese Medicine) and Oral Health Linker
map.为什么要校正放大率？: Why must the magnification factor be corrected?
map.X 线有放大，片测长度偏大；除以放大率得真实牙长，避免工作长度偏长导致超充或偏短: An X-ray image is magnified, so the measured tooth length reads too long; divide by the magnification factor to get the true tooth length, otherwise an over-long working length leads to over-instrumentation or, if too short, under-instrumentation.
map.根尖止点设在哪里？: Where should the apical stop be?
map.通常止于距解剖根尖 0.5~1mm 的根尖狭窄区，兼顾清理与窄小封闭；以电子根尖: Usually stops in the apical constriction 0.5-1 mm short of the anatomical apex, balancing cleaning against a narrow seal; an electronic apex locator assists.
map.能代替根尖定位仪吗？: Can it replace an apex locator?
map.不能。本工具为片测估算，临床以电子根尖定位仪结合片确定工作长度，由牙体牙髓科医师: No. This tool is an estimate from an image measurement; clinically the working length is determined with an electronic apex locator combined with radiographs, by an endodontist.
